$comment: Plan W10.B13 (audit W1.3, W1.4, W1.11, W1.14, W1.26, W2.2, W8.2, 4.15, W5.5, W2.10): the origin of every golden-set part and every test fixture. synthetic = written or generated here (including real text with errors we injected); real = data someone else made, used as published; derived-from-docs = real documents with items (questions, summaries, layouts) written here. Unknown provenance counts as synthetic. src/__tests__/origins.test.ts keeps this complete; scripts/golden/origin-claims.mjs flags plan statuses that call a synthetic set real.

asr-he/fleurs.why: FLEURS he_il test clips, as published

asr-he/common-voice.why: Common Voice he test clips, as published

caption/xm3600.why: Crossmodal-3600 images and their human captions

caption/owner.why: the owner's descriptions of real images (not committed)

clipper/pages.why: public-domain text (Moby-Dick) and pages written here, wrapped in layouts written for this set

data-analysis/rose.why: a real dataset (Nightingale's rose); the questions come from templates written for this set

image-search/xm3600.why: Crossmodal-3600 images with their human captions as queries

meetings/owner.why: the owner's own meeting recordings (not committed)

nikud/benyehuda.why: pointed public-domain texts from Project Ben-Yehuda

ocr-he/lines.why: line images rendered by the builder from fonts; real text

ocr-he/pages.why: synthetic pages rendered by the builder

pdf-qa/docs.why: public-domain documents rendered to PDF; 30 questions written for this set

spell-en/moby.why: real sentences with synthetic non-word errors injected

summarize/sotu.why: real State of the Union openings; reference summaries written for this set

typos-he/synthetic.why: real NTREX sentences with synthetic errors injected

ci-doctor.why: provenance not recorded: treated as synthetic

datagov.why: provenance not recorded: treated as synthetic

highlight-import.why: written for the tests (Kobo / Kindle / Readwise-shaped)

injection.why: cases written for plan 2.7 after public injection datasets (SOURCES.md); not the official set

json-canvas.why: the JSON Canvas sample, vendored with its upstream licence

knesset.why: recorded fixtures written from the documented schema (SOURCES.md); real law titles

md-spec.why: the official CommonMark and GFM spec test files, vendored unmodified

obsidian.why: written for the tests (Obsidian syntax), not from a real vault

obsidian-corpus.why: public Obsidian vaults, byte-for-byte at pinned commits (manifest.json)

paste.why: written for the tests (Word / Docs-shaped HTML)

real-corpus.why: despite the name: 7 of 8 formats are ours (render.py, notion_wa.py, LibreOffice on our documents); only evernote/ is third-party (manifest.json origin per format)

relatedGold.ts.why: generated: pairs built to share keywords

renderDocs.ts.why: the repo's own docs and templates plus synthetic cases

sefaria.why: provenance not recorded: treated as synthetic

zotero-web.why: shaped like the documented Web API responses (SOURCES.md), not captured
